sentences.text: The petitioners' land, situated over plot Nos. 414, 413, 410, 400, 193, 174 and 151, were acquired as per the notification dated 14.1.2013.
Thereafter, the award was also published on 10.2.2016 under the National Highways Act, 1956.
The petitioners, claiming themselves to be included within the meaning of affected families, applied before the relevant authorities u/s 31 of the Act, 2013.

Learned counsel for the petitioners, relying upon the judgement and order of this Court dated 21.2.2023 passed in Writ-C No. 21601 of 2022, prays that the petitioners be given additional compensation u/s 31 of the Act, 2013 as he states that the petitioners' case is covered by the judgement and order dated 21.2.2023 passed in Writ- C No. 21601 of 2022.
In this regard, the petitioners had also represented on 12.4.2023 before respondents No. 2 & 3 and thereafter repeated their prayer by means of representation dated 24.4.2023.
When no heed was paid by the respondents No. 2 & 3 on the applications filed by the petitioners, the instant writ petition has been filed.

Without going into the merits of the case, the petitioners' representation, filed on 12.4.2023 and which was followed by a reminder on 24.4.2023, be decided by the respondents No. 2 & 3 in accordance with the judgement and order of this Court dated 21.2.2023 passed in Writ C No. 21601 of 2022 within a period of one month from the date of presentation of certified copy of this order.
With these observations, the writ petition is disposed of.
This order has been passed in presence of Sri Rahul Srivastava, learned Standing Counsel, who appeared on behalf of State.
